policy.source: EXPERIMENT_SPEC.md sections 2–5; DECISIONS.md D26–D34; GEOMETRY.md contact policy
policy.placement: recorded angle in degrees (missing means 0); final fit only; motion and contacts unrotated
policy.offset: turned bounding-box lower-left at [x, z] in usable box; missing means [0, 0]; all vertices must fit
policy.floatingCreases: interior side-view vertices farther than 0.5% of sheet length from all four usable x/z walls
policy.legacyFloatingCreases: missing saved counts are reported as unavailable, not compared or assumed zero
policy.orderGrouping: sorted neighbour gaps at most 1% of sheet length / 1 degree, with transitive chaining
policy.symmetry: palindromic lengths within 1% of sheet length AND angles within 1 degree
policy.spread: 180 degrees minus largest fold angle; 180 degrees with no folds; numerical tolerance 1e-9 degree
policy.budgets: every answer checked; consecutive minFolds through minFolds + 2, capped at 11; folds <= budget
policy.scope: checks saved designs and scores; does not establish global ranking optimality or continuous collision freedom
